column5: WAF first, then MFA and API Gateway

column2: Deploy WAF first: it addresses the $31.25m annualized database injection exposure and provides the highest modeled ROI.
Deploy MFA enhancement in the same 90-day window to materially reduce account-takeover exposure.
Deploy API Security Gateway within 30 days because API bypass can directly enable unauthorized fund transfers.
Retest all three controls after implementation and track residual ALE in quarterly risk reporting.
Use the $35.0m baseline ALE as the financial reference point for funding and risk acceptance decisions.
All results are scenario-based estimates using the exploit probabilities and control effectiveness values supplied in Lab 3B.
